// @bun @bytecode
const reviewName="code-review",simplifyName="simplify",Agent="Agent",Report="ReportFindings";
function plural(count,word,other=word+"s"){return count===1?word:other}
export{reviewName,simplifyName,Agent,Report,plural};
// MODULE
// @bun @bytecode
import{reviewName,simplifyName,Agent,Report,plural}from"/bundle/runtime.js";
const reuse="Reuse original",simplification="Simplification original",altitude="Altitude original";
const cleanup=`${reuse}
${simplification}
${altitude}`;
const output=(limit)=>`## Output

Return ${limit} ${plural(limit,"finding")}. Do not call ${Report}.`;
const hostOutput=(limit)=>`Use host reporting for ${limit}.`;
const high=(format,agents=true,limit=10)=>{
  if(!agents)return "Wrong inline variant";
  return `High review via the ${Agent} tool.
${cleanup}
${format(limit)}`;
};
function route(level,format,agents=true,host=false,limit){
  switch(level){
    case "low":return "Wrong low variant";
    case "medium":return "Wrong medium variant";
    case "high":return high(format,agents,limit);
    case "xhigh":return "Wrong xhigh variant";
    case "max":return "Wrong max variant";
  }
}
function fixInstructions(host){return `## Applying fixes (--fix)

The \`--fix\` flag was passed. Fix original. ${host?"Wrong host branch":"Summarize fixes."}`}
function agentCheck(context){throw new Error("Runtime must not execute")}
function hostCheck(context){throw new Error("Runtime must not execute")}
async function reviewCommand(args,context){
  let options=readUserFlags(args),{fix:fix}=options;
  let agents=agentCheck(context),host=hostCheck(context),format=host?hostOutput:output;
  return [{type:"text",text:`${route("high",format,agents,host,10)}${fix?fixInstructions(host):""}`}];
}
const simplifyText=`/simplify
${cleanup}
Use the ${Agent} tool.`;
function register(){
  install({name:reviewName,getPromptForCommand:reviewCommand});
  install({name:simplifyName,async getPromptForCommand(args,context){
    let target=args.trim(),prefix=target?`Target ${target}`:"",text=agentCheck(context)?simplifyText:"Wrong simplify branch";
    return [{type:"text",text:`${prefix}${text}`}];
  }});
}
export{register};
